name: 性分化疾患（完全型AIS）

summary.text: Complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS) is a form of androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS), a disorder of sex development (DSD), characterized by the presence of female external genitalia in a 46,XY individual with normal testis development but undescended testes and unresponsiveness to age-appropriate levels of androgens.
